text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to reduce the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Sammon Avenue, between Coxwell Avenue and Woodbine Avenue. The implementation of the 30 km/h speed limit will promote a reduced operating speed on this section of roadway where traffic calming (speed humps) are present, and addresses the residents' concerns with regard to vehicle speeds.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Sammon Avenue, between Coxwell Avenue and Woodbine Avenue.
